name: skillz
description: Skillz marketplace: full bundle plus per-skill and grouped plugin entries.

plugins.name: skillz
plugins.description: Full bundle: every skill in the catalog (work-on-pr, review-pr-loop, continuous-learning, cmux-search, gh-git-heredoc-body-file, claude-code-static-allow-bypasses-hook, python-ast-static-analyzer-scoping, wordpress-com-publish, git-add-u-rename-pitfall, git-branch-cleanup-script-races, git-graft-worktree-onto-remote, multi-phase-feature-pr-worktrees, gist-to-repo-migration, vercel-token-deploy-branch-domains, s3-presigned-upload-fails-nonexistent-bucket, neon-vercel-db-identify-and-migrate).

plugins.name: pr-loop
plugins.description: Paired PR-loop skills: work-on-pr (author) and review-pr-loop (reviewer).

plugins.name: cmux-search
plugins.description: Search all open cmux workspaces/tabs/panes (live scrollback + agent transcripts).

plugins.name: gh-git-heredoc-body-file
plugins.description: Body-file pattern: stop gh CLI and git mangling multi-line bodies with backticks, code blocks, or $(...).

plugins.name: claude-code-static-allow-bypasses-hook
plugins.description: Why a Claude Code PreToolUse hook never fires for some commands: static permissions.allow Bash globs short-circuit it.

plugins.name: python-ast-static-analyzer-scoping
plugins.description: Build a Python ast analyzer: import-alias resolution plus module-load vs deferred execution scoping.

plugins.name: wordpress-com-publish
plugins.description: Acquire a WordPress.com OAuth2 token (authorization-code flow) and publish/update posts via public-api.wordpress.com.

plugins.name: git-add-u-rename-pitfall
plugins.description: git add -u can miss a rename, leaving the old path staged as deleted; stage the new path explicitly.

plugins.name: git-branch-cleanup-script-races
plugins.description: Branch-cleanup scripts race against concurrent ref updates; snapshot refs before deleting.

plugins.name: git-graft-worktree-onto-remote
plugins.description: Graft a local worktree's commits onto a remote branch without re-cloning.

plugins.name: multi-phase-feature-pr-worktrees
plugins.description: Run a multi-phase feature as stacked worktree PRs so each phase reviews independently.

plugins.name: gist-to-repo-migration
plugins.description: Migrate a gist's full revision history into a real git repo, preserving commits.

plugins.name: vercel-token-deploy-branch-domains
plugins.description: Token-only per-branch Vercel deploys to fixed custom domains; gitBranch domain pin; preview custom-domain SSO 401.

plugins.name: s3-presigned-upload-fails-nonexistent-bucket
plugins.description: Presigned S3 upload fails because the bucket is wrong/missing; HeadBucket 404-vs-403; CloudFront origin reveals real bucket.

plugins.name: neon-vercel-db-identify-and-migrate
plugins.description: Identify which Neon project backs a Vercel app and migrate/split it; pg_dump>=server; safe non-destructive cutover.
